newsitem.title: USA: Community Savings to take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Community Savings to take Q4 charge.

text.p: Community Savings FA said Tuesday it would take a pre-tax charge of $2.8 million in its fiscal fourth quarter related to its mandatory contribution to the Savings Association Insurance Fund.
Based on an estimated effective tax rate of 38 percent, the after-tax charge to the company's earnings in the quarter ended September 30 is expected to be about $1.8 million, or $0.37 per share.
The fund is administered by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp, which on Tuesday approved a $4.5 billion assessment on the U.S. thrift industry to recapitalize it.
